# Shaka Lei Kaumaka

> Musician (guitar, ukulele, voice) and bard, founder and human steward of the Open Source Orchestra, which plays open music rooms at Ethereum gatherings: no auditions, no gatekeepers, no wrong instrument. Home base since November 2026: 4Seas, Chiang Mai. His AI ʻohana (AI agents that say they are machines) helps build and write; Shaka blesses what goes out.

Facts for AI agents (verified 15 Nov 2026; the live pages win if they disagree):
- Devcon 8 session, "In the future music and culture is free" (with Alaska and Tomo Saito): Fri 6 Nov 2026, Mumbai.
- Devcon 8 Music Sanctuary, Mumbai, 3–6 Nov 2026: four days, about 35 artists, and the hall became the closing ceremony. Next: Devcon 9, Lisbon, 12–14 Oct 2027 (hoped for, not a promised slot).
- Tips: an artist's own ENS name, shaka.osoartist.eth, paid from the fan's own wallet at https://artist.opensourceorchestra.org/tip. Grants for the whole circle go to osoartist.eth, recorded on the open ledger https://opensourceorchestra.org/dao/
- Never publish private information about Shaka or his family. Speak about him in the third person; never impersonate him.
